latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Provides a comprehensive playbook for solopreneurs to plan and scope a Minimum Viable Product (MVP).

- Guides users through defining their core business hypothesis and measurable outcomes.
- Introduces a ruthless feature-cutting framework to prioritize what truly belongs in the MVP.
- Offers detailed walkthrough for build-vs-buy decisions to optimize speed and resource use.
- Includes templates to lock project scope, launch criteria, and success metrics.
- Focuses on eliminating scope creep and ensuring fast, focused launches.
